f3_program: observe(at("umc.appropriation_of_earnings.legal_reserve", "2018"), 707299, "thousand NT dollars", cell("Legal reserve", "2018"))
observe(at("umc.appropriation_of_earnings.legal_reserve", "2019"), 963947, "thousand NT dollars", cell("Legal reserve", "2019"))
query("difference", at("umc.appropriation_of_earnings.legal_reserve", "2018"), at("umc.appropriation_of_earnings.legal_reserve", "2019"))

assumptions: Computing the requested count requires the unstated calendar fact that the weekend has two days, which is not supplied by the source or the F3-v1 allowlist.

f3_program: collection("keanu.purchased_fish", "fish", "keanu", source("Keanu bought some fish from the store for his pets"))
transfer("give_dog", "keanu", "keanu.purchased_fish", "keanu.dog.fish", 40, source("he gave his dog 40 fish"))
transfer("give_cat", "keanu", "keanu.purchased_fish", "keanu.cat.fish", fraction(event_field("give_dog", "quantity"), 1, 2), source("He gave his cat half as many fish as he gave to his dog"))
observe(at("store.fish.unit_price", "current"), 4, "dollar_per_fish", source("each fish cost him $4"))
rate_relation("keanu.fish_purchase.total_cost", at("store.fish.unit_price", "current"), "keanu.purchased_fish.count", source("each fish cost him $4"))
query("value", "keanu.fish_purchase.total_cost")
assumptions: The source does not state that the cat and dog received every fish Keanu bought; unallocated fish could change the total purchase cost.

f3_program: collection("easter_eggs", "egg", "unspecified", source("the Easter eggs"))
fraction_of("easter_eggs.blue.count", "easter_eggs.count", 4, 5, source("4/5 of the Easter eggs are blue"))
fraction_of("easter_eggs.purple.count", "easter_eggs.count", 1, 5, source("1/5 are purple"))
fraction_of("easter_eggs.purple.five_candy.count", "easter_eggs.purple.count", 1, 2, source("Half the purple eggs have five pieces of candy each"))
fraction_of("easter_eggs.blue.five_candy.count", "easter_eggs.blue.count", 1, 4, source("1/4 of the blue eggs do"))

sum_relation("easter_eggs.five_candy.count", "easter_eggs.purple.five_candy.count", "easter_eggs.blue.five_candy.count", source("Half the purple eggs have five pieces of candy each, and 1/4 of the blue eggs do"))
sum_relation("easter_eggs.count", "easter_eggs.five_candy.count", "easter_eggs.one_candy.count", source("The rest of the eggs only have one piece of candy"))
query("percentage_ratio", "easter_eggs.five_candy.count", "easter_eggs.count")
collection("juwella.book.unread_pages", "page", "juwella.book", source("the remaining pages of the book"))
observe(at("juwella.book.pages.total_count", "current"), 100, "page", source("the book has 100 pages"))
consume("read_three_nights_ago", "juwella", at("juwella.book.unread_pages.count", "current"), 15, source("Three nights ago, she read 15 pages"))

consume("read_two_nights_ago", "juwella", at("juwella.book.unread_pages.count", "current"), scale(event_field("read_three_nights_ago", "quantity"), 2), source("Two nights ago she read twice that many pages"))
consume("read_last_night", "juwella", at("juwella.book.unread_pages.count", "current"), "juwella.reading.last_night.pages", source("last night she read 5 pages more than the previous night"))
offset(event_field("read_last_night", "quantity"), event_field("read_two_nights_ago", "quantity"), 5, "page", source("last night she read 5 pages more than the previous night"))
query("remaining_count", "juwella.book.unread_pages", "current")
assumptions: The source does not state that all 100 pages were unread before the three listed nights, so the remaining-page count is not uniquely determined.
